;!0,0,0,0,0,173,173,

         ░░░▌ Font Convert ▐░░░

    █ █ █ version for ZAsm 3.15 █ █ █

███▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀███

███ ZAsm 3.15 edition .... 16.04.2018 ███
███▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄███

        CHD "D:"
        INCLUDE "ovldef"

Font1   EQU #6800
Font2   EQU #7000

        ORG Overlay

        JP Start
        DB NumVers
        DW 0,0
        DW OvlWins
        DW OvlTokn
        DS 8

Start   RFS CLOSA
        ld hl,FNC_MNU:RFS MENU:ret

FNC_OPN RFS OUTFS:DB WN,#80,23,0,6
 DB "Font Convert",23,2,3
 DB "Screen to Standart",#D
 DB "Standart to Screen",#ff:RET

        DW FNC_OPN
FNC_MNU DB 0,2
 DB 2,1,0,0,#41:DW FntCnv
 DB 3,1,0,0,#41:DW FntCnv

FntCnv  call FntLoad:retnc
        call FntCnv1:call FntSave:ret 

FntCnv1 ld hl,Font1:ld de,Font2
        ld a,(FNC_MNU):or a:jrz _2Std

_2Scr   ld b,8:ld c,d 
_2Scr1  ld a,(hl):ld (de),a:inc hl,d 
        djnz _2Scr1:ld d,c 
        inc e:jrnz _2Scr:ret 

_2Std   ld b,8:ld c,h
_2Std1  ld a,(hl):ld (de),a:inc de,h
        djnz _2Std1:ld h,c
        inc l:jrnz _2Std:ret 

FntLoad ld a,(FNC_MNU):or #80
        RFS PANEL:RFS CLOSA:retnc 
        ld a,(23773+#D):cp 8:jrnz _NLoad
        ld de,(23773+#E):ld bc,#0805
        ld hl,Font1:call Tr_Dos:scf:retz
_NLoad  and a:ret 

FntSave ld a,(FNC_MNU):xor 1:add a,2
        or #80:ld de,FntName
        push de:RFS InFNM:pop hl:retnc 
        call MakeNam0:ld de,Font2
        ld hl,Font2+2048:RFS WFILE:ret 

OvlWins
w0
 db 0
 db %01101011,%11000000
 db #02,#04,#12,#5,ColMenu

 DB #FF

OvlTokn
 db "Load *.fn1",#ff
 db "Load *.fnt",#ff
 db "Save *.fnt",#ff
 db "Save *.fn1",#ff

FntName
 DS 14,#20:DB #D

          SAVEOBJ "fcnv.ovl"

          ;23412341234123412341234
          ╔════ Font Convert ════╗
          ║                      ║
          ║  Screen to Standart  ║
          ║  Standart to Screen  ║
          ╚══════════════════════╝
